'''Ryern''' was, along with [[Aurell/Legends|Aurell]], one of two [[Star/Legends|stars]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Auratera system/Legends|Auratera system]]. The system contained three [[Planet/Legends|planets]], all of which exclusively orbited Aurell, which was the larger of the two stars.<ref name="NoP" />

Ryern was occasionally eclipsed by Aurell, and was far dimmer.<ref name="NoP" />
